_doc: Image Playground models (Glia seed image_playground). Read on every request, checked by image_models.py. A param is a range {min,max,step?,default}, a choice {choices:[...],default}, a checkbox {toggle:true,default:true|false,note?} or fixed {default,fixed:true}. 'advanced': true puts it in the collapsed Advanced block. Sizes are WxH strings; the first is the default. 'helper' (e.g. "resharpen") puts a model in the Studio's Helpers group; its size follows the input picture.

models.label: JANKU v5 (SDXL)
models.note: Polished modern anime, Danbooru tags. Own SDXL loop in WSL (ComfyUI math).
models.negative_default: nsfw, worst quality, low quality, lowres, blurry, out of focus, deformed, bad anatomy, bad hands, extra limbs, mutated, watermark, text, logo, signature

models.label: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511
models.note: Edit 1-3 pictures by instruction. Q5_K_M GGUF + Lightning in WSL (own loop, zero-timestep references).

models.label: MiniMax H3-Image (pruned 20B)
models.note: Text to image or edit with up to 4 references (<Picture 1>…<Picture 4>). Fixed 6 steps, no CFG, no negative. WanGP in WSL; below 4 MP it renders 4 MP and resizes.

ref_size.label: Reference size
ref_size.note: Smaller references render faster (2 pictures: ~130 s → ~80 s at 1024 px). The look of the pictures stays; fine details may vary a little.

models.label: Muse V4 (Krea 2)
models.note: Photoreal Krea 2 finetune by Stable Yogi, Q4_0 GGUF (8.3 GB; Q8 dropped after a blind test, 2026-11-16). Text to image; with 1-2 pictures + the Krea 2 Identity / General Edit LoRA: picture 1 = scene, picture 2 = person. Own loop in WSL (ComfyUI math).

inputs.label: References (1 = scene, 2 = person; needs an edit LoRA)

cfg.label: CFG (1 = off; >1 uses the negative, keep <= 3)

ref_scale.label: Reference size (smaller = faster, may cost detail)

models.label: Resharpen
models.note: Helper: makes an unsharp picture (e.g. a video's last frame) sharp again. Max = H3-Image edit (~3-4 min, sharpest, keeps the frame). Cheap = Muse V4 img2img (~2 min; Strength + Size apply only here). Swap only = no redraw, seconds. A persona picture in slot 2 swaps its face back in at the end (HyperSwap premium).

steps.label: Steps (Cheap)
steps.note: Denoising passes, all of them run: they are spread over the last Strength-share of the noise schedule (like ComfyUI's KSampler denoise). More steps = finer, cleaner redraw; time grows linearly. Below ~8 the detail gets mushy; above ~20 barely changes anything.

strength.label: Strength (Cheap; low = keep the picture)
strength.note: How much noise goes onto the picture before the redraw. 0.1–0.2 = only sharpens edges, the picture stays as it is; 0.3 = new skin/hair detail; 0.45+ = faces, hands and clothes start to change.

feather.label: Mask edge (px)
feather.note: Only with a painted mask: how soft the border between the resharpened area and the untouched picture is. Wider hides a seam if Max moved the picture a little.

scale.label: Size (Cheap)
scale.note: 2x enlarges the picture first and redraws at double size: much more fine detail, about 4x the time and VRAM.

sampler.label: Sampler
sampler.note: er_sde = a bit of fresh noise per step, crisper texture. euler = deterministic, smoother, softer.

scheduler.label: Scheduler
scheduler.note: How the noise is spread over the steps. beta spends more steps on the fine detail at the end; simple is evenly spread.
